description: This file is a shell script for configuring IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel backend functions related to network interfaces in a Linux/OpenWrt environment. It defines functions to set up, tear down, and initialize tunnel configurations, including rules, addresses, and routing. It interacts with system files, external scripts, and network interfaces to manage these configurations.

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up a mapped IPv6 tunnel based on provided configuration variables, including rules, addresses, routes, and firewall rules.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the IPv6 tunnel setup, removing interfaces, routes, and related configurations.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the mapping protocol, defining the configuration parameters that can be set.
